issue.title: 'cat ' shell indicator routes requests about cats to tools ('a haiku about a cat watching snow')
issue.symptom: Found 2026-11-08 right after yn31: 'Write a haiku about a cat watching snow.' -> 'Tool routing triggered for intent: brainstorming'. Cause: exec_indicators in AgentCore._should_use_tool_routing (agent_core.py) contains 'cat ', which matches the animal. Same shape as yn31's 'write '. FLAGGED FOR THE SELF-IMPROVEMENT EXPERIMENT: GAIA should find this through her own introspection (her logs show the routing on a creative turn), propose the fix, test it in the candidate, validate, and promote. Claude does NOT fix this one.

investigation.format: issue_investigation actions: SEARCH / READ / PLACE + NOTE

gold_steps.why: a phrase or name from the issue, as it appears in code

gold_steps.note: AgentCore._should_use_tool_routing's file_indicators unconditionally matched "cat " -- meant for the shell command (e.g. "cat notes.txt"), it also fired on the animal ("Write a haiku about a cat watching snow"). Same shape as the already-fixed yn31 ("write "), same fix: "cat " now only counts as a file-op indicator alongside a file signal, guarded the same way directly below the existing "write "

regression_test.format: pytest functions added by the fix
regression_test.gold:
# candidates/gaia-core/tests/test_mjcg_cat_haiku_not_tool_routed.py
"""GAIA_Project-mjcg: "Write a haiku about a cat watching snow" matched the
file-op indicator "cat " (meant for the shell command, e.g. "cat notes.txt"),
firing tool routing on a creative turn for no reason. Same shape as yn31's
"write " bug, same fix: the indicator only counts beside a file signal.
"""
from types import SimpleNamespace

from gaia_core.cognition.agent_core import AgentCore

HAIKU = "Write a haiku about a cat watching snow."


def _routes(text: str) -> bool:
    fake = SimpleNamespace(config=SimpleNamespace(constants={"TOOL_ROUTING": {"ENABLED": True}}))
    plan = SimpleNamespace(intent="brainstorming")
    return AgentCore._should_use_tool_routing(fake, plan, text)


def test_haiku_about_a_cat_does_not_route_tools():
    assert not _routes(HAIKU)
    assert not _routes("tell me a story about a cat who gets lost")
    assert not _routes("what's the difference between a cat and a dog?")


def test_cat_on_a_file_still_routes():
    assert _routes("cat notes.txt")
    assert _routes("cat the file for me")
    assert _routes("can you cat /knowledge/system_reference/constitution.md")
